subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. if there is no error, select 'No error'.**

During the summer months, there is shortage of power in much parts of the country.

options.text: in much parts of the country

solution:
The erroneous part is **'in much parts'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'in many parts'** should be used instead of **'in much parts'.**
 
• '**Much**' is used to describe mass nouns or non-count nouns like *juice, rice, patience, and happines*s.
